samples.xml_description:
Implement a 64-bit ripple carry adder with 16-bit registers for pipelining. Clock input. Active low reset signal. Enable signal for addition operation. 64-bit input operand A. 64-bit input operand B. 65-bit output representing the sum of adda and addb. Output enable signal. 4 Pipeline register for the enable signal. Pipeline register for input operand A. Pipeline register for input operand B. Pipeline register for the result. Pipeline register for the output enable signal.

Implement the 64-bit ripple carry adder with 16-bit registers for pipelining.

Use the following algorithm:

  1. Register the input enable signal (i_en) in the first pipeline stage.
  2. Register the input operands (adda and addb) in the second pipeline stage.
  3. Calculate the sum of the corresponding 16-bit subsections of adda_reg and addb_reg, along with the carry from the previous stage, in the third pipeline stage.
  4. Register the result in the fourth pipeline stage.
  5. Output the result and the output enable signal (o_en_reg) in the same cycle.
